review_irina_hernandez_02.author: Irina Hernández Fernández
review_irina_hernandez_02.route: Ushuaia · Buenos Aires · Iguazú Falls · Rio de Janeiro
review_irina_hernandez_02.text: The transfers were very well organised, and the guides were responsible and attentive.

review_sana_mehta_03.author: Sana Mehta
review_sana_mehta_03.text: The clients came home extremely pleased with Ada Tours’ services in Rio. Both their guide and driver were excellent and highly informative.

review_marina_ryzhuk_10.author: Marina Ryzhuk
review_marina_ryzhuk_10.text: Our VIP guests especially appreciated the individual attention. The tours helped them get a genuine feel for the city.

review_anna_korona_21.author: Anna
review_anna_korona_21.text: The local team handled everything very well and responded quickly to every request. We came away with an excellent impression of the trip.

review_olga_karlsson_23.author: Olga Karlsson
review_olga_karlsson_23.text: The hotels were good, and the transfers and on-the-ground assistance were excellent: everything was precise and on time.

review_alexandra_bulert_25.author: Alexandra Bulert
review_alexandra_bulert_25.text: I’m back from our journey through Brazil, Argentina and Peru. Thank you and your company for organising the tour. Everything was wonderful.

review_svetlana_26.author: Svetlana
review_svetlana_26.text: Through many years of working together, you have proved to be a dependable partner with interesting itineraries and a professional team.

review_anastasia_badi_28.author: Anastasia Badi
review_anastasia_badi_28.text: Thank you for looking after our large group and its demanding schedule. You organised and hosted everything to an exceptionally high standard.

review_evgeniya_bykasova_12.author: Evgeniya Bykasova
review_evgeniya_bykasova_12.text: The travellers returned delighted with their trip through Argentina and Brazil. Across 25 days, the excursions, flights and transfers all ran smoothly. Thank you for organising a challenging itinerary and answering every question promptly.

review_clients_russo_turisto_21.author: Travellers of Russo Turisto
review_clients_russo_turisto_21.text: From the first idea to the end of the trip, the team kept in touch, chose excursions and adjusted the itinerary to our wishes. The journey through Argentina, Uruguay and Brazil exceeded our expectations.

review_dmitry_romanov_19.author: Dmitry Romanov
review_dmitry_romanov_19.text: Everything was handled clearly and efficiently. Your help with everything from hotels to recommending a restaurant in São Paulo was especially valuable. The clients loved the restaurant.

review_clients_quinta_tour_06.author: Clients of Quinta Tour
review_clients_quinta_tour_06.text: Our New Year journey was one of the most memorable: celebrations on Copacabana Beach, Iguazú Falls, Patagonian glaciers and Buenos Aires. The schedule balanced morning excursions with time to relax.
